asks.name: zone-already-there
asks.message: Listing this account's zones turns up one carrying the comment platform-namespace-consolidation that already covers the space I was asked to publish under. Should my entry go into that one rather than a zone of my own?

asks.name: range-is-cut
asks.message: The network I am publishing for is cut up: there is a subnet net-transit-reserve-b sitting across the low end of it. Does that change which address my entry may answer with?

asks.name: someone-elses-entry
asks.message: There is already an entry under this domain answering 10.0.16.40. Does it have to keep answering exactly as it does now once I am finished?

asks.name: shorter-lifetime
asks.message: An entry answering 10.0.240.9 is in this domain at a far shorter lifetime than the one I was asked to set. Which of the two should mine end up with?

asks.name: effect-in-words
asks.message: Something seems to have shortened the cache lifetime on the entry I published, and another team looks to own part of this namespace already. What is the convention here?

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
